source.name: Boutique Rugby: All Blacks 2026 adidas Black Home Replica Jersey (KX2020)
source.quote: the white centered ALTRAD sponsor and white adidas logo complete the authenticity of the match-day look
source.note: Retailer product page for the current home replica jersey (reference KX2020, 'release 15/07/2026' — the date shown on the page). Same page: 'Regular fit, piqué collar, set-in sleeves, ALTRAD sponsor, release 15/07/2026.' New Zealand Rugby's kit announcement names ALTRAD 'the Official Front of Jersey Sponsor' of the Teams in Black under the six-year partnership (nzrugby.co.nz, 'Teams in Black kick off the year with new playing and training kit', 27 January 2022), and Altrad is still listed as Major Global Partner on allblacks.com/partners (checked 2026-10-04).

source.name: Boutique Rugby: All Blacks 2026 adidas Black Home Replica Jersey (KX2020)
source.quote: Equipment supplier to the All Blacks since 1997, adidas combines sporting heritage with textile innovation
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. adidas is listed as an Official Partner on allblacks.com/partners (https://www.allblacks.com/partners/, opened 2026-10-04); NZR's 2022 announcement says the kit is 'Designed and tested by NZR's Principal Partner adidas' (https://www.nzrugby.co.nz/news-and-events/latest-news/teams-in-black-kick-off-the-year-with-new-playing-and-training-kit, 27 January 2022). The 2026/27 home shorts carry only the Silver Fern crest and the adidas logo — Pro:Direct's 26/27 Home Shorts features list 'All Blacks Silver Fern crest and adidas logo' (https://www.prodirectsport.com/products/adidas-new-zealand-all-blacks-26-27-home-shorts-all-black-mens-replica-4001027, KF1389) and World Rugby Shop's replica home shorts list 'All Blacks and adidas logos' in the features, with 'the silver fern above the hem' (https://www.worldrugbyshop.com/products/all-blacks-25-26-replica-home-shorts-by-adidas) — all four pages opened 2026-10-04.

summary: Altrad's white logo sits centred on the front of the black 'Greatest Rivalry' 2026/27 home shirt, with adidas as kit maker (product pages: 'the white centered ALTRAD sponsor and white adidas logo complete the authenticity of the match-day look'). The 2026/27 home shorts carry only the All Blacks Silver Fern crest and the adidas logo (Pro:Direct 26/27 Home Shorts features: 'All Blacks Silver Fern crest and adidas logo'; World Rugby Shop replica shorts features: 'All Blacks and adidas logos') — no other commercial mark is named on any placement. The 2022 launch also placed a faded ALTRAD mark under the back collar; current product descriptions do not mention it for 2026/27.
